svg.metadata: {"story":"Abraham","act":2,"chapter":"Egypt and Return","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Famine drives Abram into Egypt, where fear leads him to present Sarai as his sister — and Pharaoh's household pays the price until the truth surfaces.
